question: Can any homogeneous Lindblad logarithm realize the supplied full marked source channel, and which continuous source-operator completions preserve the actual marked transfer words?
summary_de: Alle zeitunabhaengigen GKSL-Logarithmen des vollstaendigen markierten M4-Kanals und aller positiven ganzzahligen Potenzen sind ausgeschlossen, ohne Zwischenzeit-Kovarianz anzunehmen. GNS-Hilbertzeit und klassischer B-Transfer bleiben gueltig. Exakte Suche in den fuenf vorhandenen Clifford-Spruengen ergibt sechs Ecken und einen dreidimensionalen B-kompatiblen Ratenbereich. Vollstaendige markierte M2-Wortantwort plus komplementaere SO3-Symmetrie waehlen bedingt Raten log(3/2)/4 und log(6)/12; weitere Quellantworten aendern sich. Physische Auswahl, geladene Sektorwechsel und TFPT-Gesamtabschluss offen.
search_method: exact symbolic linear elimination and exhaustive vertex enumeration; finite-group twirl and analytic all-branch proof
assumptions: The already supplied full marked M4 channel is held fixed only for the homogeneous-embedding exclusion
A finite-dimensional time-homogeneous GKSL interpretation is a tested extra premise, not a requirement for GNS Hilbert reconstruction
The constructive comparison is restricted to nonnegative jumps using the five existing native Clifford vector words
Complementary SO3 covariance and the full supplied marked M2 transfer-word data are extra constructive conditions
Neither the five-jump class nor its physical source selection is derived from P1/P2
kills: A nonprincipal or noncovariant homogeneous Lindblad logarithm embeds the same full marked M4 channel
Blocking six or any positive integer number of steps restores homogeneous GKSL embeddability of that same full channel
The original B readout uniquely fixes the continuous five-vector-jump rates
A genetic search can infer the missing physical source selection from identical zero-error B readouts
Equality of all marked M2 transfer words implies equality of the full M4 channel or of arbitrary instrument-resolved histories
not_derived: Physical selection of a reduced channel, GNS field time or continuous completion from the literal raw seam functional
Source-derived complementary Clifford responses and physical insertion instruments
Native charged Spin10 sector-changing fields or a full CAR/CCR source map
Physical 3+1D, chirality, interactions, gravity or T1-T8 closure
